verdict.rationale: Fathom documents webhooks that push each meeting's AI-generated action items (include_action_items) to a URL you choose, with signature verification. A REST API, TypeScript/Python SDKs and an official MCP server let an agent pull meeting data. The leg that files items into Linear, Jira or Asana is not evidenced at all, so the user must build that glue themselves. Missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integration or automation, a documented action-items API endpoint or example tracker workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
